(In this sense जनः or अयं जनः is often used by the speaker-whether male or female, in the sing. or pl.--instead of the first personal pronoun to speak of himself in the third person); अयं जनः प्रष्टुमनास्तपोधने Ku. 5. 40 (male); भ गवन्परवानयं जनः प्रतिकूलाचरितं क्षमस्व मे R. 8. 81 (female); पश्यानंगशरातुरं जनमिमं त्रातापि नो रक्षासि Nāg. 1. 1 (female and pl.). --3 Men collectively, the people, the world (in sing. or pl.); एवं जनो गृह्णाति M. 1; सतीमपि ज्ञातिकुलैकसंश्रयां जनोऽन्यथा भर्तृमतीं विशंकते Ś. 5. 17. --4 Race, nation, tribe. --5 The world beyond Maharloka, the heaven of deified mortals. --ना Birth, production. --Comp. --अतिग a. extraordinary, uncommon, superhuman. --अधिपः, --अधिनाथः {1} a king. {2} N. of Viṣṇu. --अंतः {1} a place removed from men, an uninhabited place. {2} a region. {3} an epithet of Yama. {4} personal proximity. --अंतिकं secret communication, whispering or speaking aside (to another). (--ind.) aside (to another) (in dramas); the S. D. thus defines this stage direction: --त्रिपताककरेणान्यानपवार्यांतरा कथां . अन्योन्यामंत्रणं यत् स्याज्जनांते तज्जनांतिकं .. 425. --अर्णवः a large concourse of people, caravan. --अर्थशब्दः a family appellation. --अर्दनः an epithet of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa. --अशनः a wolf. --आकीर्ण a. thronged or crowded with people; Ś. 5. 10. --आचारः {1} a popular usage or custom. {2} propriety, decorum. --आश्रमः an asylum for people, an inn, caravansary. --आश्रयः a pavilion. --इंद्रः, --ईशः, --ईश्वरः, a king. --इष्ट a. desired or liked by the people. --(ष्टः) a kind of jasmine. --(ष्टा) turmeric. --उदाहरणं glory, fame. --ओघः a concourse of people, crowd, mob. --कारिन् m. lac. --चक्षुस् n. ‘the people's eye’, the sun. --जन्मादिः the Supreme Being. --त्रा an umbrella, a parasol. --देवः a king. --पदः {1} a community, race, nation; Y. 1. 361 v. l. {2} a kingdom, an empire, an inhabited country; जनपदे न गदः पदमादधौ R. 9. 4; दाक्षिणात्ये जनपदे Pt. 1; Me. 48. {3} the country (opp. the town पुर, नगर); जनपदवधूलोचनैः पीयमानः Me. 16. {4} the people, subjects (opp. the sovereign); जनपदहितकर्ता त्यज्यते पार्थिवेन Pt. 1. 131. {5} mankind. --पदिन् m. the ruler of a country or community. --प्रवादः {1} rumour, report. {2} scandal, calumny. --प्रिय a. {1} philanthropic. {2} liked by the people, popular. --(यः) {1} an epithet of Śiva. {2} coriander-seed. --मरकः an epidemic disease. --मर्यादा established custom or usage, popular custom. --रंजनं gratifying the people, courting popular favour. --रवः {1} rumour. {2} calumny, scandal. --लोकः one, (i. e. the fifth), of the seven divisions of the universe situated above Maharloka. --वादः (also जनेवादः) {1} news, rumour. {2} a scandal. --व्यवहारः popular usage. --श्रुत a. well-known among people, famous. --श्रुतिः f. a rumour, report. --संबाध a. densely crowded with people. --स्थानं N. of a part of the Daṇḍakā forest; R. 12. 42; 13. 22, U. 1. 28, 2. 17.

a: जनमेजयः — N. of a celebrated king of Hastināpura, son of Parīkṣit, the grandson of Arjuna. [His father died, being bitten by a serpent; and Janamejaya, determined to avenge the injury, resolved to exterminate the whole serpent-race. He accordingly instituted a serpent sacrifice, and burnt down all serpents except Takṣaka, who was saved only by the intercession of the sage Āstīka, at whose request the sacrifice was closed. It was to this king that Vaiśampāyana related the Mahābhārata, and the king is said to have listened to it to expiate the sin of killing a Brāhmaṇa.].

s: strI, (janmanaH SrIkfzRotpatterazwamI tiTiH .) BAdrakfzRAzwamI । sA ca SrIkfzRasya janmatiTiH । sA tu muKyacAndreRa SrAvaRasya kfzRAzwamI gORacAndreRa BAdrasya । tatra SrIkfzRasya janmakAlo yaTA, brahmapurARe । “aTa BAdrapade mAsi kfzRAzwamyAM kalO yuge । azwAviMSatime jAtaH kfzRo'sO devakIsutaH ॥” vizRupurARe mahAmAyAM prati BagavadbAkyam । “prAvfwkAle ca naBasi kfzRAzwamyAM mahAniSi । utpatsyAmi navamyAntu prasUtiM tvamavApmyasi ॥ SrAvaRe vA naBasye vA rohiRIsahitAzwamI । yadA kfzRe narErlabDA sA jayantI prakIrtritA ॥” agnipurARe । “rohiRIsahitA kfzRA mAsi BAdrapade'zwamI । saptamyAmardDarAtrADaHkalayApi yadA Bavet ॥ tatra jAto jagannATaH kOstuBI harirISvaraH । tamevopavaset kAlaM tatra kuryyAcca jAgaram ॥ avidDAyAYca sarkzAyAM jAto devakInandanaH ॥” iti saptamyaveDe janmaSravaRakalpaBedAdavirudDam ॥ navamyAdiyogasya praSaMsA yaTA । brahmavEvartte । “udaye cAzwamI kiYcinnavamI sakalA yadi । Bavettu buDasaMyuktA prAjApatyarkzasaMyutA । api varzaSatenApi laByate vA na vA viBo ! ॥” padmapurARe । “pretayonigatAnAntu pretatvaM nASitantu tEH । yEH kftA SrAvaRe mAsi azwamI rohiRIyutA ॥ kiM punarbuDavAreRa somenApi viSezataH । kiM punarnavamIyuktA kulakowyAstu muktidA ॥” upavAsAdiPalaM yaTA, BavizyapurARe । “ekenEvopavAsena kftena kurunandana ! । saptajanmakftAt pApAnmucyate nAtra saMSayaH ॥” brahmavEvartte । “manvAdidivase prApte yat PalaM snAnapUjanEH । PalaM BAdrapade'zwamyAM Bavet kowiguRaM dbija ! ॥ tasyAntiTO vArimAtraM pitFRAM yaH prayacCati । gayASrAdDaM kftaM tena SatAbdaM nAtra saMSayaH ॥” upavAsAkaraRe dozo yaTA, Bavizyottare । “SrAvaRe'bahule pakze kfzRajanmAzwamIvratam । na karoti naro yastu sa Bavet krUrarAkzasaH ॥ varze varze ca yA nArI kfzRajanmAzwamIvratam । na karoti mahAkrUrA vyAlI Bavati kAnane ॥” skAnde । “na karoti yadA vizRorjjayantIsaMjYakaM vratam । yamasya vaSamApannaH sahate nArakIM vyaTAm ॥” Bavizye । “tuzwyarTaM devakIsUnorjjayantIsaMjYakaM vratam । karttavyaM cintyamAnena BaktyA BaktajanEH saha ॥ akurvvan narakaM yAti yAvadindrAScaturddaSa ॥” tatropavAsakramaH, BavizyapurARe । “pArTa ! taddivase prApte dantaDAvanapUrvvakam । upavAsasya niyamaM gfhRIyAdBaktiBAvataH ॥ vAsudevaM samuddiSya sarvvapApapraSAntaye । upavAsaM karizyAmi kfzRAzwamyAM naBasyaham ॥ adya kfzRAzwarmAM devIM naBaScandrasarohiRIm । arccayitvopavAsena Bokzye'hamapare'hani ॥ enaso mokzakAmo'smi yadgovinda ! triyonijam । tanme muYcatu mAM trAhi patitaM SokasAgare ॥ AjanmamaraRaM yAvadyanmayA duzkftaM kftam । tat praRASaya govinda ! prasIda puruzottama ! ॥” gfhamupakramya । “tanmaDye pratimA sTApyA kAYcanAdivinirmmitA । prataptakAYcanABA sA devakI sutapasvinI ॥ mAYcApi bAlakaM suptaM prasUtA nIradacCavim । vasudevo'pi tatrEva KaqgacarmmaDaraM sTitam ॥ yaSodA cApi tatrEva prasUtavarakanyakA । balaBadrastaTA nando dakzo gargaScaturmuKaH ॥ evaM saMpUjayedBaktyA ganDapuzpAkzatEH PalEH । sTaRqile sTApayeddevIM sacandrAM rohiRIntaTA ॥ devakIM vasudevaYca yaSodAM nandameva ca । caRqikAM baladevaYca pUjya pApEH pramucyate ॥ ardDarAtre vasorDArAM pAtayedguqasarpizA । tato vardDApanaM zazWIM nAmAdeH karaRaM mama ॥ karttavyaM tatkzaRAdrAtrO praBAte navamIdine । yaTA mama taTA kAryyo BagavatyA mahotsavaH ॥ brAhmaRAn BojayedBaktyA teByo dadyAcca dakziRAm । suvarRaM kAYcanaM gASca vAsAMsi kusumAni ca ॥ yadyadizwatamaM loke kfzRo me prIyatAmiti । yaM devaM devakI devI vasudevAdajIjanat ॥ BOmasya brahmaRo guptyE tasmE brahmAtmane namaH । subrahmavAsudevAya gobrAhmaRahitAya ca ॥ SAntirastu SivaYcAstu ityuktrA tAn visarjjayet ॥ evaM yaH kurute devyA devakyA sumahotsavam । varze varze Bagavato madBaktyA Darmmanandana ! । naro vA yadi vA nArI yaToktaPalamApnuyAt ॥ puttrasantAnamArogyaDanaDAnyardDimadgfham । samparkeRApi yaH kuryyAt kaScijjanmAzwamIvratam ॥ vizRulokamavApnoti naro nAstyatra saMSayaH ॥” pUjA ca maDyarAtre gAruqe । “kfzRAzwamyAntu rohiRyAmardDarAtre'rccanaM hareH ॥” vratapAraRayoH kAlaniyamaH । ekadine jayantIlABe tatrEvopavAsaH । uBayadine cettadA paradine । jayantyalABe tu rohiRIyuktAzwamyAm । uBayadine rohiRIyutAzwamIlABe paradine tadalABe tu niSITasambanDinyAmazwamyAM uBayadine niSITasambanDe tadasambanDe vA paradine iti । upavAsaparadine tiTinakzatrayoravasAne pAraRam । yadA mahAniSAyAH pUrvvamekatarasyAvasAnamanyatarasya mahAniSAyAM tadanantaraM vA tadEkatarAvasAne pAraRaM yadA mahAniSAyAmuBayasTitistadA utsavAnte pAraRam .” iti tiTyAditattvam ॥ * ॥ hariBaktivilAsamate tUpavAsakAlo yaTA, -- “janmAzwamI pUrvvavidDA na karttavyA kadAcana । palaveDe tu viprendra ! saptamyAM cAzwamIM tyajet ॥ surAyA bindvanA spfzwaM gaNgAmBaHkalasaM yaTA । vinA fkzeRa karttavyA navamIsaMyutAzwamI ॥ safkzApi na karttavyA saptamIsaMyutAzwamI । tasmAt sarvvaprayatnena tyAjyamevASuBaM buDEH ॥ veDe puRyakzayaM yAti tamaH sUryyodaye yaTA । yacca vahnipurARAdO proktaM vidDAzwamIvratam । avEzRavaparaM tacca kftaM vA devamAyayA ॥” pAraRakAlo yaTA, -- “yadvA tiTyarkzayoreva dbayorante tu pAraRam । samarTAnAmaSaktAnAM dbayorekaviyogataH ॥ kecicca Bagavajjanmamahotsavadine SuBe । BaktyotsavAnte kurvvanti vEzRavA vratapAraRam ॥” tadbratakaTA yaTA, -- “ekadA SrIkulAcAryyaM vaSizWamfzisattamam । rAjA dilIpaH papracCa vinayAvanataH suDIH ॥ dilIpa uvAca । BAdre mAsyasite pakze yasyAM jAto janArddanaH । tatkaTAM SrotumicCAmi kaTayasva mahAmune ! ॥ kaTaM vA BagavAn jAtaH SaNKacakragadADaraH । devakIjaWere vizRuH kiM karttuM kena hetunA ॥ vaSizWa uvAca । SfRu rAjan ! pravakzyAmi yasmAjjAto janArddanaH । pfTivyAM tridivaM tyaktrA Bavate kaTayAmyaham ॥ purA vasunDarA hyAsIt kaMsArAGanatatparA । svADikArapramattena kaMsadUtena tAqitA ॥ krandantI lajjitA sApi yayO GUrRitalocanA । yatra tizWati deveSa umAkAnto vfzaDvajaH ॥ kaMsena tAqitA nATa ! iti tasmE niveditam । vAspaDArAM pravarzantIM vivarRAmapamAnitAm ॥ krandantIM tAM samAlokya kopena sPuritADaraH । umayA sahitaH sarvvErddevavfndEranudrutaH ॥ AjagAma mahAdevo viDAturBavanaM ruzA । gatvA covAca brahmARaM kaMsaDvaMsanimittakam ॥ upAyaH sfjyatAM brahman ! BavatA vizRunA saha । ESvaraM tadbacaH SrutvA gantuM prAkrAmadAtmaBUH ॥ kzIrode yatra vEkuRWaH suptaH sa Bujagopari । haMsapfzWe samAruhya harerantikamAyayO ॥ tatra gatvA hariM DyAtvA devavfndErharAdiBiH । tuzwAva BagavAn vAgBirarTyABirvvAgvidAmbaraH ॥ namaH kamalanetrAya haraye paramAtmane । jagataH pAlayitre ca lakzmIkAnta ! namo'stu te ॥ namaH kamalakiYjalkapItanirmmalavAsase । namaH samastadevAnAmaDipAya mahAtmane ॥ namo brahmaRyadevAya gobrAhmaRahitAya ca । jagadDitAya kfzRAya govindAya namo namaH ॥ iti teByaH stutIH SrutvA pratyuvAca janArddanaH । devA namramuKAH sarvve BavatAmAgamaH kaTam ॥ brahmovAca । SfRu deva ! jagannATa ! yasmAdasmAkamAgamaH । kaTayAmi suraSrezWa ! tadahaM lokatAraRa ! ॥ SUlidattavaronmattaH kaMsarAjo durAsadaH । vasuDA tAqitA tena padAGAtena muzwinA ॥ varaM dattvA purApyugro mAyayA sa pravaYcitaH । BAgineyaM vinA rAjan ! SAstA na BavitA tava ॥ tasmAdgacCa svayaM deva ! hantuM kaMsaM durAsadam । devakIjaWare janma laBa gatvA ca gokulam ॥ brahmaRA prezito vizRuH pratyuvAca paSoH patim । pArvvatIM dehi deveSa ! abdaM sTitvAgamizyati ॥ umayA ramayA sArdDaM SaNKacakragadADaraH । uddiSya maTurAM cakre prayARaM kaMsanASanam ॥ devakIjaWare janma leBe vizRurgadADaraH । yaSodAkukzimaDye tu sarvvARI mfgalocanA ॥ nava mAMsAMSca viSrAmya kukzO navadinADikAn । BAdre mAsyasite pakze azwamIsaMjYayA tiTO ॥ rohiRItArakAyuktA rajanI DanaGoritA । GUmayonO taqidyukte vAri varzati sarvvadA ॥ tasyAM jAto jagannATaH kaMsArirvvasudevajaH । vErAwe nandapatnI ca yaSodAjIjanat sutAm ॥ puttraM padmakaraM padmanABaM padmadalekzaRam । ramyaM caturBujaM SAntaM SaNKacakragadADaram ॥ tadA kranditumAreBe dfzwvA cAnakadunduBiH । tatrEva vARyaBUddEvI devakImAtragocarA ॥ puttraM dattvA yaSodAyE kanyAM tasyAH samAnaya । kaMsAsuraBayAttaM hi uvAca devakI tadA ॥ vErAwaM gacCa viprendra ! sutaM pratyarpituM praBo ! । puttraM dattvA yaSodAyE sutAM tasyAH samAnaya ॥ tAM dfzwvA kaMsarAjo'pi saBAyAM na hanizyati । tasyA vacaH samAkarRya vasudevo'tiduHKitaH ॥ aNke kumAramAdAya vErAwABimuKaM yayO । yamunA jalasaMpUrRA tatpaTe maDyavarttinI ॥ atiSrotA mahAvIryyA sutIkzRormmiBayAkulA । tAM dfzwvA tattawe sTitvA yamunAmavalokayan ॥ vasudevo'tiduHKArtto vilolacetano'Bavat । kiM karomi kva gacCAmi viDinAtrApi vaYcitaH ॥ kaTamadya gamizyAmi vErAwe nandamandiram । hariRA tatra sAnandaM mAyayA vaYcitaH pitA ॥ kzaRamAtraM tawe sTitvA yamunAmapyalokayat । tena dfzwA punaH sApi kzIRA jAnuvahABavat ॥ tataH so'pi puro dfzwvA DAvantaM Kalu jambukam । kroqe kftvA sutaM svEraM gantuM pAraM pracakrame ॥ taM dfzwvA hfzwacittantu BagavAn yamunAjale । mAyAM kftvA jagannATo hyaNkAt sa patitaH pituH ॥ taM sutaM patitaM dfzwvA sUryyajAjIvane dbijaH । tadA kranditumAreBe BAle GAtvA karaM dfQam ॥ viDinA vEriRA hyatra duHKito'haM pravaYcitaH । trAhi mAM jagatAM nATa ! puttraM dehi surottama ! ॥ janakaM kranditaM dfzwvA kaMsAriH kfpayA viBuH । jalakrIqAM samAcaryya pituraNke'vasat punaH ॥ paTA tena dbijaSrezWo gatavAnnandamandiram । sutaM dattvA yaSodAyE sutAM tasyAH samAnayat ॥ sutAmaNke taTA so'pi gfhItvAnakadrunduBiH । nijAgAraM punaH prApya pratyarpya tAdfSIM sutAm ॥ pratiyujya pade lohamAsIt pUrvvavadAvftaH । devakI ca prasUteti vArttA prAptA surAriRA ॥ AnetuM prahito dUtaHsutaM duhitaraYca vA । Agatya kaMsadUto'sO sutAM netuM pracakrame ॥ balAdaNkAt samAkfzya devakIvasudevayoH । kaMsadUto gfhItvA tAM kaMsAyAdarSayat punaH ॥ dfzwvA tAM kaMsarAjo'pi saBayo'BUddurAsadaH । SudDakAYcanavarRABAM pUrRendvasadfSAnanAm ॥ dfzwvA kaMso vihasyantIM vidyutsPuritalocanAm । AdideSAsuraSrezWo vaDa nItvA Silopari ॥ AjYAM labDvAsurAste tu nizpezwuM tAM pravarttitAH । vidryudrUpaDarA gOrI jagAma SaNkarAntikam ॥ antarIkze kzaRaM sTitvA kaMsaM provAca SaNkarI । tvAM hantuM gokule jAtaH pUrvvaSatrurna saMSayaH ॥ tatrAtizWajjagannATaH kaMsAriH surakftyakft । krIqitvA bAlaBAvena kaMsaDvaMse mano daDO ॥ prAptimAtreRa taM kaMsaM jaGAna jagadISvaraH । etatte kaTitaM rAjan ! kfzRajanmAzwamIvratam ॥ ya idaM kurute rAjan ! yA ca nArI harervratam । prApnotyESvaryyamatulamiha loke yaTepsitam ॥ antakAle hareH sTAnaM durllaBaYca gamizyati । ekenEvopavAsena kftena kurunandana ! ॥ saptajanmakftAt pApAnmucyate nAtra saMSayaH । vatsaradvAdaSe cEva yat puRyaM samupArjjitam ॥ viPalaM tadBavet sarvvaM purA vyAsena BAzitam । na drazwavyaM suKaM tezAM narARAM na ca yozitAm ॥ jayantI na kftA yEstu jAgarAdisamanvitA । SvAnaScEte tu vijYeyA jayantIvimuKA narAH ॥ yozitaSca na sandehaH satyoktaM tava suvrate ! ॥” iti BavizyapurARe vaSizWadilIpasaMvAde SrIkfzRajanmAzwamIvratakaTA samAptA ॥
